summary.value: Also known as the Dreadful, the Champion, Vigilante.

system.description:
Built on Project FU's Magical Girl (TailsPr v1.0).

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points
  • Ritualism rituals

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise.)

PENNY KNIGHT SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000181]{Stand Revealed} 【Max SL 4】

Choose an element at acquisition (air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, ice or light). Grants the Panoply and the Token; each level adds an enchantment.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000182]{In Their Name} 【Max SL 5】

When a damaging spell you cast in the Panoply hits and its Magic Check invoked a Bond of admiration, loyalty and/or affection: +(SL) damage, and the spell ignores Immunities and Resistances, as printed.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000183]{Kindly Light}

Your Panoply entry damage may instead heal — chosen targets gain Absorption against that instance.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000184]{The Inexhaustible} 【Max SL 5】

In the Panoply, casting a non-offensive spell of 10+ MP recovers (SL × 2) MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000185]{Interposition}

When a creature makes a Magic Check, spend a Fabula Point and choose a Bonded ally you can see: +(2 + Bond strength) Magic Defense against it — a hit may become a miss. Once per round.
